text:
rachel: Heads-up: a few mobile customers reporting immediate reconnects (ws 1006) after very small frames. Appears only when traffic passes the edge proxy on cellular networks.

tom: Any pattern in frame sizes?

rachel: lots of 12-48B frames, often gzip-wrapped. Mobile SDKs appear to treat a tiny non-utf8 fragment as stream end.

igor: interesting, mobile TCP stacks + Nagle interactions could be fragmenting net writes. Proxy might be flushing tiny packets through. Did we change http2 flush recently?

rachel: yes, a perf tweak to reduce latency on the edge. Direct-to-runtime doesn't reproduce; bypass fixes it.

neha: ops ask for visibility: can we add metrics for small-frame rate and "mobile reconnect rate" (label by sdk=mobile/native)? Also a console badge on route page: "stream-retry-risk" that flags tenants with frequent reconnects.

tom: agree metrics first. We'll emit stream.small_frame_count, stream.mobile_reconnect_rate, and tag by route+tenant+sdk. No payloads, just hashes and lengths.

igor: mitigation options: revert flush change (broad), add proxy coalesce for tiny writes (opt-in), or add SDK-side backoff to avoid immediate reconnect/double-submit. Mobile SDK change slower.

rachel: mobile SDKs are slow to ship. Prefer proxy coalesce opt-in per route with CLI flag for rollback. Heuristic: buffer up to 80 bytes or 30ms; if buffer looks like valid utf8 JSON send early. Exempt one-byte heartbeats.

neha: add console guardrails: route page shows tiny-frame spike chart and an action button to enable coalesce for that route (experimental). Also add alert: mobile_reconnect_rate > 3x baseline for 5m.

tom: note latency tradeoff: coalescing can add 8-20ms tail latency. We'll show p50/p95 coalesce_latency_ms on the UI.

igor: privacy note: never store frame payloads. Send only length+sha256(prefix) to traces.

deploy-bot: canary: edge-proxy/staging -> deployed 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z (canary id c-1400).

rachel: quick staging run with coalesce 80B/30ms reduced mobile reconnects 10/min -> 1/min for test tenants. p95 token latency +11ms. Holding canary for 90m.

neha: UX follow-up: add "stream-retry-risk" badge on route list and a details pane listing impacted tenants with links to billing export rows. Make it read-only for now (flag-only).

tom: once metrics and badge are live, we'll notify #incidents and support before 50% rollout.

igor: I'll open PR for the proxy change and add the CLI toggle --coalesce-small-frames=false for quick rollback. Tests + emulator included.

rachel: thanks. Will monitor and post if anything regresses. :eyes:
